text: NG12 1.2.4: Consider non-urgent direct access upper gastrointestinal endoscopy to assess for oesophageal or stomach cancer in people aged 55 or over with treatment-resistant dyspepsia [1]. Dyspepsia that has failed to settle on two courses of acid suppression is the presentation this project was built around [2]. Acidity or indigestion lasting more than 42 days has outlasted a self-limiting cause and should be tested now rather than treated again [3, 4].
